simple.meaning: מָזוֹן (mâzôwn) is a Hebrew object word meaning “food.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 45:23. The surrounding context includes family, family line, city, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָזוֹן (H4202) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מָזוֹן (mâzôwn) / H4202 is traced through Genesis 45:23, 2 Chronicles 11:23 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.full: H4202. mazon מָזוֺן noun masculine food, sustenance (so Talmud, Biblical Aramaic, Syriac) — וּמָזוֺן וָלֶחֶם בָּר Gen 45:23 (Di ' ׳מ rather an Aramaic word; perhaps later gloss for original צֵדָה 45:21 ; 42:25 '); לָרֹב הַמָּזוֺן 2Chr 11:23 . זוֺנָה see זנה .

occurrences.englishText: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.
He dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them food in abundance and he sought many wives for them.
